1.combo: volcano_disasters|none|pyroclastic cloud races down into a village street|hillside terrace above the village##HKK:V2|bystander_handheld
1.prompt: 0-4s: From the very first frame a single huge pyroclastic cloud races down the flank of the volcano, glowing lava pouring down the slope behind it, and slams into the far end of a hillside village of low tin-roofed houses among palm trees far below. Six people, small in the distance, run up the village street toward the camera. 4-9s: One man trips and falls; right in front of him the cloud snaps a power pole and it crashes across the road in a burst of sparks, and he scrambles up and runs on. 9-15s: The cloud tears the roof tiles off the houses just below the terrace and hurls them toward the camera, then engulfs the terrace in thick brown ash. Handheld footage shot from a terrace high on a steep hillside, far above the rooftops, the whole village spread out below, looking down over the village street toward the erupting volcano; slight hand shake, the camera stays fixed on the terrace, tilting down no more than slightly and never descending, the erupting volcano always visible in the upper third of the frame, a corner of the terrace railing in the foreground; one continuous shot, no zoom, no cuts. Bystanders wear civilian clothes, no hazmat suits. Raw natural light under an ash-grey sky, never glossy or CGI. No readable signs, text or flags.
